name: Marcos Ros Sempere - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the role of cohesion policy investment in resolving the current housing crisis
part_text:
1. This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It asks the European Commission and Member States to use "cohesion policy" money — EU funds meant to even out differences between regions — to help people find affordable homes. It wants more money for social and affordable housing, simpler rules, and help for young people, older people, people with disabilities and homeless people. It also asks for housing to stay affordable long-term, not sold off for speculation.

- Changes: none yet; it asks to double housing funds in the current budget review.
- Affects: national, regional and local authorities, plus people struggling with housing costs.
- Next: the Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
